# A trigger and an assertion inside a loop in a test body run once per
# iteration on every target, for a condition loop and a loop over a list.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output {
    go {
        bubbletea
        fyne
        gtk4
    }
    kotlin {
        android
    }
    none {
        html
    }
}

component main node {
    var hits = 0
    button #k(text="k{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
}

func testLoops(t Test, c main) {
    var i = 0
    for i < 3 {
        c.k.click()
        i = i + 1
    }
    t.assert(c.hits == 3)
    for var n = [1, 2] {
        c.k.click()
        t.assert(c.hits == 3 + n)
    }
    t.assert(c.hits == 5)
}

window {
    main
}
